user.title: Connect to your ChargePoint charger
user.description: Enter the local IP and the 64-character API token from the charger's advanced settings page. The local REST API must be enabled.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with the charger
reauth_confirm.description: The API token for {host} is no longer accepted. Generate a new token in the charger's advanced settings and paste it here.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the charger at that address.
error.no_serial: Connected, but the charger did not report a serial number.
error.wrong_device: Connected, but the serial number does not match the original device. Refusing to silently re-point this entry at a different charger.
error.unknown: Unexpected error talking to the charger.

authorize_charge_session.name: Authorize charge session
authorize_charge_session.description: (De)authorize a charge session on the charger using a token from the local list.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry ID
config_entry_id.description: Advanced - target a config entry by its ID instead of by device.

readonly_access.title: Charger API is in ReadOnly mode
readonly_access.description: The charger at {host} ({title}) reports its local REST API is in ReadOnly mode, so the integration cannot create the Number, Switch, or authorize service entities. To enable these, open the charger's web UI, go to advanced settings, switch the local REST API to ReadWrite, then reload this integration. See the linked documentation for screenshots.
